Texas Secretary of State — results.texas-election.com
=====================================================

Source (fetched 2026-10-27):
  https://results.texas-election.com/static/data/election/49664/1012/Federal.json
  https://results.texas-election.com/static/data/election/49664/1012/StateWide.json
  https://results.texas-election.com/static/data/election/49664/1012/Districted.json
  https://results.texas-election.com/static/data/election/49664/1012/StateWideQ.json
  https://results.texas-election.com/static/data/election/49664/1012/Home.json
  https://results.texas-election.com/static/data/election/49664/1012/Race.json

Election: 2024-11-05 general (election id 49664, data version 1012), the most recent
general in ElectionConstants_404.json at fetch time.

Trimming: Federal.json keeps president, U.S. Senate and US House districts 1, 2 and 34;
Districted.json keeps SBOE 1, SBOE 13 (unexpired term), state senate 6 and state house 1;
Race.json keeps the first three offices of each office type. Candidate arrays and all
other fields are verbatim. StateWideQ.json is the real (empty) file — 2024 had no
constitutional amendments on the general ballot.
